data_plane.postgresql: transactional system of record and domain invariants
data_plane.redis: cache and bounded ephemeral state; never sole source of truth

event_plane: NATS JetStream baseline; Kafka/Redpanda/Pulsar benchmark only until ADR proves replacement or second bus.
workflow_plane: No workflow engine is default. Temporal/Prefect/Dagster/Airflow/Celery are evaluated per workload; event transport and durable workflow are distinct concerns.
ai_plane: Elyrava is framework-neutral. Agent/model/tool/memory/research implementations are adapters behind CFIP contracts.
dependency_rule: inbound adapter -> application -> domain <- outbound ports/adapters
oss_boundary: OSS dependencies terminate at explicit capability adapters; Domain, Core IP and canonical contracts never depend on vendor implementations.
anti_sprawl: one canonical runtime implementation per production capability unless ADR
no multiple search/vector systems without benchmark/ADR
no multiple workflow engines without ADR
no direct infrastructure access from agents/domain
no OSS runtime adoption by popularity
no service extraction without measurable need
